summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to require Medicare and Medicaid to cover the first three primary care visits each year, starting in 2026, without any cost-sharing for the patient.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends the Social Security Act to require Medicare and Medicaid to cover three primary care visits annually without cost-sharing. This expands access to healthcare services under public programs, pushing towards more public healthcare.

By expanding Medicare and Medicaid benefits to include cost-free primary care visits, the bill strengthens the social safety net by making essential healthcare more accessible and affordable for beneficiaries of these programs.
